'''Alexandre Dufresne Rebel Fleet Deck 1 0''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Alexandre Dufresne]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10018">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10018 Rebel Fleet Deck 1 0], DeckTech (Alexandre "Lord Kenobi" Dufresne, 30 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10018/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10018/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018125643/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10018/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Rebel Fleet Deck 1 0'''
* '''Author:''' Alexandre "Lord Kenobi" Dufresne
* '''Published:''' August 30, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is mainly a space deck.

=== Strategy ===

The main idea of this deck is to beat the crap out of your opponent in space and use the enhanced characters like Obi and Luke to control the ground with Zev and Rogue 2 to take care of walkers (if the opponent uses them). Ohter than that just force drain and battle when you have the advantage.
